name: Ironjaw Enforcer's Full Combat Street Kit
description: Matte-black segmented trauma armor worn over a tight gunmetal compression underlayer, paired with reinforced thigh-pocket cargo pants in charcoal ripstop and mag-lace combat boots with ankle-plate inserts. The shoulder and forearm armor panels are aug-compatible with full chrome-arm clearance channels, and the back panel has a reinforced spinal rig slot. It reads as private security from a distance — up close, the lack of any corporate logo says otherwise.
functionality: Trauma-rated armor panels with aug-compatible chrome-arm channels and spinal rig slot; mag-lace boots allow single-pull emergency boot removal.
what_it_says: This person is the last warning before things become irreversible.
story_hooks: The armor bears a barely-sanded-off logo from a now-dissolved corporate security firm — someone knows exactly who this person used to work for.
The spinal rig slot contains a kill-switch override chip that the wearer's employer installed without telling them.

physical_description.visual_profile: Aggressive, utilitarian silhouette with pronounced shoulder and forearm plating. Reads as paramilitary or private security at distance, but deliberate absence of corporate branding signals independent operator or street-tier enforcer. Angular, segmented aesthetic creates visual weight across chest and arms. Compact, combat-ready posture.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight through torso and underlayer; segmented armor plates sit proud of the body with intentional gaps for mobility. Cargo pants relaxed through hip, tapered at ankle with articulated thigh pockets. Boots structured and rigid.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte-black ballistic polymer segments over gunmetal synthetic-spandex compression layer. Charcoal ripstop nylon cargo pants. High-friction rubber and reinforced polymer boot construction.
physical_description.texture: Armor panels are smooth, slightly reflective matte finish with visible segmentation lines and rivet details. Underlayer is smooth and glossy where visible. Cargo fabric has tight weave texture. Boot material shows subtle scuffing and wear resistance.
physical_description.color_scheme: Monochromatic blacks and charcoal grays. Gunmetal silver accent at compression layer neckline and cuff edges. No bright colors or corp branding. Weathered finish suggests active use.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap connectors on armor segments for field-quick removal. Friction-fit compression underlayer. Cargo pants feature utility-style friction buckles at thigh pockets. Combat boots use reinforced lacing with tension locks.
distinctive_features: Segmented modular armor plating with individual articulation
Aug-compatible chrome-arm clearance channels in shoulder and forearm panels
Reinforced spinal rig slot in back panel for equipment harness
Full thigh-pocket cargo configuration with retention straps
Ankle-plate inserts in boots for foot protection and stability
Intentional lack of corporate logos or identification markings
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 functional combat gear. Too professional-grade for corpo security (which maintains strict branding), too street-modified for licensed enforcement.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street enforcer, private debt collector, ungoverned sector security, militant activist, or independent operator. Signals someone who engages in physical confrontation and doesn't answer to corporate oversight.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn but maintained. Armor panels show minor scuffs and impact marks. No tears or patches — user replaces damaged segments rather than repairs. Underlayer faded from repeated cleaning. Boots show combat creasing.

image_prompt: Full-body shot of muscular, mixed-race cyberpunk enforcer wearing segmented black matte armor over gunmetal compression underlayer, charcoal ripstop cargo pants with mag-lace boots. Shoulder and forearm plating sharp-edged and prominent. Standing in aggressive tactical stance in dim industrial warehouse setting with cool blue and amber sodium lighting.
